subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this grouped third-party Action upgrade for workflows that handle OpenAI, GitHub App, and registry credentials?
rationale: The code preserves the Codex Action safety configuration, but accepting revised external executable commits on credential-bearing workflow paths is a repository security-boundary decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve after owner audit
options.body: Review the upgraded action revisions and completed current-head workflow results, then accept the batch if the CI/security owner is satisfied.

options.title: Split the sensitive updates
options.body: Land non-secret-bearing action updates separately and defer Codex, GitHub App-token, and registry-login revisions for dedicated review.

recommendation.title: Approve after owner audit
recommendation.body: Review the upgraded action revisions and completed current-head workflow results, then accept the batch if the CI/security owner is satisfied.
